sellListing.clientPath: trade -> parent.trade -> deferred channel equip -> socket event equip

creation.stackable: Requested q is moved from inventory into a new trade-slot item. The remaining inventory stack stays in inventory.
creation.nonStackable: The physical inventory item is moved into the trade slot and receives price/rid.

sellListing.replacement: Direct replacement is rejected with slot_occuppied. Existing sell listing must be removed/filled before a new listing can occupy the slot.

removal.rule: Trade slot is cleared; non-buy-listing item is returned to inventory.

buyListing.clientPath: wishlist -> parent.wishlist -> deferred channel trade_wishlist -> socket event trade_wishlist
buyListing.replacement: An existing buy listing (b=true) in the same slot may be overwritten directly. The replacement receives a new rid.

removal.rule: Trade slot is cleared; because b=true the virtual wishlist item is not moved into inventory.

slotAvailability.rule: Listing creation rechecks get_trade_slots(player) at mutation time.

ridSemantics.serverCheck: Server rejects item_gone when data.rid is present and differs from the current slot rid.
ridSemantics.fullFillResult: slot becomes null; old rid is no longer valid because the listing no longer exists.
ridSemantics.meaning: Optimistic slot-replacement guard, not a transaction id, not an idempotency key, not a quantity version and not a globally unique listing identity.
ridSemantics.rule: Every new trade intent must use a fresh listing observation and must pin both rid and listing fingerprint.

partialFillSemantics.partialFillDefinition: Requested q is smaller than the current listing q; exactly requested q transfers and the listing remains.
partialFillSemantics.consequence: A stale quantity can coexist with a still-matching rid. RID alone cannot prove quantity freshness.

targetRequirements: seller and buyer are not in bank
listingChecks: listing is a sell listing (b/giveaway rejected)
buyer inventory can accept requested q
serverMutationOrder: seller gold credited net of seller tax
seller listing removed or q decremented
tradeBuy.settlementRule: Own buyer gold + own buyer inventory are primary settlement evidence. Remote listing delta is supporting evidence only because other buyers may mutate the same listing.

targetRequirements: buyer and seller are not in bank

notComparedBySelection: arbitrary special/provenance fields not named in the predicate
serverItemSelection.v5Rule: Immediately before send, reproduce the server scan against the fresh inventory and prove that the exact server-selected physical item is permitted by policy. If multiple server-eligible variants are not fungible under policy, deny/replan.

serverMutationOrder: seller gold credited net of seller tax
tradeSell.settlementRule: Own seller inventory + own seller gold are primary settlement evidence. Wishlist quantity alone can never prove that this seller executed the trade because another seller may fill the same wishlist.

concurrency.serverExecution: trade_buy and trade_sell handlers are synchronous in the server source and re-read the current target slot/quantity before mutating it.
concurrency.targetLocality: Target player is resolved from the current server-process players map; market interaction requires a live nearby target.
concurrency.implication: Concurrent requests to one live listing are processed against the then-current listing state; a later request observes the prior handler's remove/decrement.
concurrency.noOversellByStaleQuantity: Server checks current q for every request and either transfers exactly requested q or rejects.
concurrency.recoveryWarning: A remote listing q decrease after UNKNOWN is not proof that our request committed, because another actor can cause the same q decrease.

v5Policy.quantityPolicy: Requested quantity is immutable within one intent. Never convert a server rejection into an automatic smaller quantity on the same intent.
v5Policy.continuationPolicy: For multi-fill goals, each follow-up fill is a new intent from a new live listing observation.
v5Policy.unknownSettlement: Do not infer commit from remote listing quantity alone. Reconcile own value/inventory under exclusive managed resource claims; remote listing is secondary evidence.
v5Policy.listingReplacementPolicy: Any new rid or fingerprint change invalidates the planned intent and requires a full replan.

invariants: trade_buy and trade_sell raw writes always carry a non-empty freshly observed rid even though the server handler conditionally checks rid only when supplied.
RID is an optimistic replacement guard, never an idempotency key or transaction identifier.
RID does not rotate on partial fill; remaining quantity must be freshly observed independently.
One trade intent requests one exact quantity; the server either applies that requested quantity or rejects it.
A server rejection for insufficient remaining quantity creates a replan opportunity, never an automatic downsized retry.
Every follow-up partial fill is a new intent from fresh listing truth.
Listing identity is scoped by target + slot + rid + side/item/level/price fingerprint; rid alone is not treated as globally unique.
A remote listing quantity delta alone cannot settle an UNKNOWN trade because other players can mutate the same listing.
trade_sell reproduces the server's inventory scan immediately before send and proves the selected physical item is allowed.
trade_sell is denied when multiple server-eligible physical variants are not fungible under the configured value policy.
Sell-listing replacement requires removal/full fill first; wishlist replacement may overwrite b=true and creates a new rid.
Listing creation/removal and trade execution use their documented local FIFO channels but still require V5 resource admission across channels.
